justifications.r1: Svella taps to create Icy Manaliths, producing permanent cumulative mana rocks every turn.
justifications.r2: Svella's 8-mana ability digs 4 cards deep and casts spells for free.
justifications.a1: Big mana threats and untapper redundancy.
justifications.a2: Engine compounds with Seedborn Muse on Turns 5–6.
justifications.p1: Presents huge Eldrazi / Apex monster threats on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: Requires 2 opponent untap steps for combat.
justifications.p3: Icy Manaliths accumulate visibly on board.
justifications.i1: Gruul destroy spells and artifact hate.
justifications.i2: Seedborn Muse untaps all permanents on every player's turn to activate Svella 4 times per turn cycle.
justifications.s2: Icy Manaliths survive creature wipes, ensuring immense mana persists.
justifications.s3: Deck requires Svella to create the mana rocks.
